# Template: spec.md

**Generated by:** architect agent, after producing all architecture views.
**Approved by:** user (SPEC approval gate — mandatory before developer starts).
**Consumed by:** developer (primary input), tester (AC section), QA (AC + boundaries).

## What spec.md IS and IS NOT

| IS | IS NOT |
|---|---|
| Decisions + rationale | Duplicate of architecture contracts |
| Acceptance criteria (testable) | Implementation instructions |
| Boundaries (do/ask/never) | Code or SQL |
| Cross-stack contract bridge | Stack-specific detail |
| Pre-conditions | Design or architecture narrative |

**Rule:** If a section already exists in an architecture view, reference it — do NOT copy it. The architecture files are the source of truth for contracts.

---

## Template

```markdown
# SPEC: <Feature name> — <TASK-ID>

## Contexto y objetivo

<!-- One paragraph. What problem this solves and why now. -->

## No-objetivos

<!-- Explicit scope exclusions. What this task does NOT do. -->
- ...

## Pre-condiciones

<!-- What must be true / exist before this task can start. -->
- [ ] Migration XXX applied
- [ ] Feature YYY deployed
- [ ] ...

## Decisiones tomadas (ADR)

<!-- One block per non-obvious decision. Use MADR format. -->

### ADR-01: <Título>

- **Opciones consideradas:** A (pro/con) · B (pro/con) · C (pro/con)
- **Decisión:** Elegimos [opción] porque [fuerza principal].
- **Tradeoff aceptado:** ...

<!-- Repeat per decision -->

## Mapa de contratos (cross-stack)

<!-- Only for tasks that touch multiple stacks. Maps the boundary between them. -->
<!-- Detail lives in architecture files — this table shows the connection. -->

| Productor | Contrato | Consumidor | Ver en |
|---|---|---|---|
| Go `EventWriter` | `ToolUsePayload.InputSizeBytes int` | Rust store `input_size_bytes` | architecture-backend.md §handler |
| Rust `McpRetryLoopDto` | `{ toolName, count, windowStart }` | React `McpRetryLoop` interface | architecture-backend.md §DTOs |

<!-- For async: also document the channel/topic that connects them -->
| Productor | Topic / Queue | Contrato (event) | Consumidor |
|---|---|---|---|

## Mapa de implementación

<!-- File-level plan. Action = CREATE / MODIFY / DELETE. -->
<!-- This is what the developer follows — be specific about what changes, not how. -->

| Archivo | Acción | Qué cambia | Referencia | Fase |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `path/to/file.go` | MODIFY | Add `UpdateToolUseDuration` method | architecture-backend.md §writer | 1 |

## Criterios de aceptación

<!-- Testable. Format: GIVEN / WHEN / THEN. One per observable behavior. -->
<!-- Group by feature if multiple features in scope. -->

### <Feature 1>

1. GIVEN ... WHEN ... THEN ...
2. GIVEN ... WHEN ... THEN ...

### <Feature 2>

3. GIVEN ... WHEN ... THEN ...

## Requerimientos de observabilidad

<!-- What this feature must emit. Not optional for Medium+ tasks. -->
- **Logs:** campos obligatorios en operaciones críticas (ej. `run_id`, `tool_name`, `duration_ms`)
- **Métricas:** counters/gauges que esta feature expone (o "N/A — feature puramente UI")
- **Spans / traces:** si hay operaciones distribuidas, qué spans se crean

## Límites de implementación

### Siempre hacer
- ...

### Preguntar antes de hacer
- ...

### Nunca hacer
- ...

## Tests esperados — por stack

<!-- Closed list. Tester implements exactly these — no more, no less. -->
<!-- Group by stack. Each with file path and what it validates. -->

#### Tests Go
- `path/to/file_test.go` — `TestFunctionName`: valida que ...

#### Tests Rust
- `src-tauri/tests/file_test.rs` — `test_function_name`: valida que ...

#### Tests React/TS
- `src/features/.../file.test.tsx` — `"description"`: valida que ...
```

---

## Rules

- spec.md is generated AFTER all architecture views — it references them, not the other way around
- Every AC must be testable as-is — "system works correctly" is not an AC
- Implementation Map must list every file the developer will touch — no surprises mid-task
- Pre-conditions section is mandatory — if empty, write "Ninguna" explicitly
- Cross-stack contract bridge is mandatory for any task touching 2+ stacks
- Observability section is mandatory for Medium+ tasks — "N/A" requires explicit justification
- "Tests esperados" is the closed list the tester follows — architect sets scope, not tester
- Keep spec.md under 150 lines — if longer, contracts are being duplicated from architecture files
